topic: API endpoint refactoring and streaming response
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on technical development updates. One participant reported refactoring the main endpoint in the ml-api to use a sax json parser, incorporating chunk processing and streaming response capabilities. This was done via a pull request submitted to another team member. The discussion confirmed that while the initial request still consumes memory for the full byte array, the subsequent processing is handled efficiently using streaming methods.
decisions: The main endpoint in ml-api was refactored to use sax json parser with chunk processing and streaming response.
